offering_description.value: Operates a digital platform that helps consumers find and save on prescription drug prices through discount cards and price comparison, plus paid memberships and telehealth visits. It earns from consumer subscriptions, pharmacy and manufacturer fees, and healthcare services.

primary_products.value: prescription discount cards; GoodRx Gold membership

customer_segment.value: B2C: US consumers buying prescription drugs without insurance or with high copays; B2B: pharmaceutical manufacturers, pharmacy benefit managers, health plans, retail pharmacies

end_markets.value: healthcare; pharmaceuticals; retail pharmacy; digital health

revenue_model.value: subscription: consumers paying for GoodRx Gold membership; advertising: pharmaceutical manufacturers paying for brand drug promotion on the platform; transaction or usage fees: fees from pharmacies and benefit managers for prescriptions filled through discount cards; service fees: consumers paying for telehealth visits and related care
revenue_model.category: subscription; advertising; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: consumer app and website connecting patients, pharmacies and drug makers; service provider: telehealth visits and prescription savings services sold to consumers and plans

geography_served.value: US national: all US states, with discount cards accepted at pharmacies nationwide

specialization.value: related lines: discount cards, membership subscriptions and telehealth, sharing consumers and pharmacy partners

distribution_channels.value: online: GoodRx mobile app and website where consumers find and use discounts; partners / resellers: retail pharmacies and pharmacy benefit managers that accept discount cards; direct sales: sales of advertising and data services to pharmaceutical manufacturers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: telehealth and health data subject to HIPAA, FTC consumer protection and state pharmacy and telehealth rules

notes: Current revenue mix and telehealth offerings may have changed since my information was last updated.
